source_artifact.content_excerpt: The promote loop never fired once — treat evidence push-and-curate architecture dead weight, not evidence needs more discipline. Invert direction: leave learnings written, make consumption query-time join — cheap journal_query.py greps/indexes every workspace repo's LEARNINGS.md/DECISIONS.md, wired as mandatory low-cost step in /plan and /investigate ('has any repo already learned about X?'). 0-promotions ledger stops failure promotion stops mechanism; genuinely transcendent clusters, if they ever appear, surface as repeated query hits — an observable trigger — rather than requiring a curation ceremony nobody performs. /promote demoted to optional archival pass (not deleted outright), also pays the plugin-portfolio consolidation dividend.
source_artifact.title: Cross-repo learning consumption query-time join at /plan and /investigate
